description: Thresholds of the end-to-end run (scripts/e2e.sh, the e2e CI job): the built binaries against real Qdrant and real embeddings from text-embeddings-inference, with canned plans and answers. Separate from 'thresholds' in questions.json, which hold for the fake bag-of-words embeddings of the in-process harness. Scope accuracy and flagged negative controls are also hard checks. See docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#end-to-end-tests.
